systemOfRecordFor: DAO smart contracts and deployment code
on-chain proposals, votes, timelock, and execution records
taskstaffAuthorityFor: technical, legal, treasury, and security reviewer assignments
execution readiness, conflicts, evidence, and outcome verification

missions.name: Proposal-to-verified-outcome governance
missions.objective: Staff proposal review and execution with independent governance, technical, legal, treasury, and security roles before any on-chain or treasury action, then verify the delivered outcome.
missions.why: A valid on-chain transaction does not prove that the proposal was adequately reviewed, safely staffed, executed by the correct authority, or verified against the promised outcome.

roles.title: Proposal owner
roles.responsibility: Define the requested change, rationale, measurable outcome, implementation plan, dependencies, and evidence without self-approving the proposal.

roles.title: Governance reviewer
roles.responsibility: Verify process, scope, voting requirements, conflicts, member impact, and consistency with approved governance policy.

roles.title: Technical and security reviewer
roles.responsibility: Review contract behavior, upgrade path, tests, threat model, deployment parameters, rollback or pause capability, and execution risk independently from implementation.

roles.title: Treasury and legal reviewer
roles.responsibility: Review financial exposure, authority, restrictions, conflicts, agreements, and required approvals before vote or execution readiness.

roles.title: Execution operator
roles.responsibility: Execute only the approved and queued action through the authorized wallet, Safe, timelock, or role and preserve transaction evidence.

roles.title: Independent outcome verifier
roles.responsibility: Confirm that the executed action produced the approved result, identify residual gaps, and accept, conditionally accept, or reject outcome closure.

controls.title: Proposal and reviewer separation
controls.description: Prevent the proposal owner or implementer from serving as the sole governance, technical, security, treasury, legal, execution, and outcome authority.

controls.title: On-chain execution readiness gate
controls.description: Require approved proposal text, completed reviews, vote and quorum evidence, timelock state, exact execution payload, simulation, authorized signer readiness, and incident response posture.

controls.title: Post-execution outcome acceptance
controls.description: Keep the proposal operationally open until the expected on-chain and off-chain outcomes, documentation, communications, and residual risks are independently verified.

expectedShortfalls: A proposal may lack independent legal, treasury, technical, or security reviewer capacity.
Execution payload, signer, timelock, or deployment simulation evidence may be incomplete.
The proposal may define an action without measurable post-execution success criteria.
resultingGaps: A proposal cannot safely progress to vote or execution readiness.
Treasury, upgrade, access-control, or governance risk may remain undisclosed.
An executed transaction may be treated as complete without proving the promised ecosystem outcome.
prohibitedAutomation: No agent may cast a governance vote, sign a wallet transaction, execute a timelock action, move treasury assets, approve legal risk, or accept governance residual risk.
No successful transaction receipt may substitute for independent outcome verification.

marketingProof.proofStatement: Demonstrate that TaskStaff governs the off-chain people, authority, evidence, and QA/QC required around a DAO proposal without controlling votes, wallets, or treasury execution.
proofGates: Use local or testnet transactions only during the pilot.
Wallet signing and on-chain execution must remain outside TaskStaff authority.
Security, legal, treasury, and governance claims require their authorized reviewers.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim that TaskStaff controls, secures, audits, or guarantees the DAO, token, treasury, or smart contracts.
Do not claim fewer governance failures or improved participation without outcome-verified evidence.

implementation.nextAction: Validate the manifest and run a local or testnet proposal scenario with independent governance, technical/security, treasury/legal, execution, and outcome-verification roles.
